name: Wizschool: Ancient Book of Magic
storyline: Players enroll in the Elandry Academy to learn magic potion creation. They engage in puzzle battles against various characters and progress through 7 story chapters, uncovering mysteries within the academy and ultimately aiming to save the land
summary: A puzzle-RPG (specifically match-3 with RPG elements) where players join the Elandry academy, a wizard school, to master potion creation. Players battle against AI opponents, explore various locations, and follow a story involving mysterious events at the academy, aiming to save the land.The gameplay involves matching tiles to meet quotas or battle opponents, incorporating RPG elements like character evolution and item shops
